```{r functions, include=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
get_acquisition_params <- function(path, outfile = stderr()) {
  ds_params <- stringi::stri_split_regex(basename(path), pattern = "\\.")[[1]]
  if (length(ds_params) < 5) {
    cat(
      "Failed to obtain acquisition parameters from the path given!\n",
      file = outfile
    )
    NULL
  }
  ds_expt <- as.numeric(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[1]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]][[2]])
  ds_res <- as.numeric(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[2]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]][[2]])
  ds_mode <- as.numeric(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[3]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]][[2]])
  ds_dev <- as.integer(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[4]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]])
  ds_dev <- ds_dev[which(!is.na(ds_dev))]
  ds_range <- as.numeric(stringi::stri_split_regex(
    ds_params[[5]],
    pattern = "[\\D]+"
  )[[1]][[2]])
  list(
    expt_id = ds_expt,
    resol_id = ds_res,
    pol_id = ds_mode,
    dev_id = ds_dev,
    mzrange_id = ds_range
  )
}
get_cv_model_summary <- function(model, x_data, y_data) {
  tumor_idx <- which(
    stri_count_fixed(levels(y_data), "6") > 0
  )
  data_predicted <- predict(
    model$bestModel,
    newdata = x_data,
    type = "prob"
  )
  roc_data <- pROC::roc(
    y_data,
    data_predicted[, levels(y_data)[tumor_idx]]
  )
  best_tune_idx <- which(model$results$lambda == model$bestTune$lambda)
  list(
    # Гиперпараметры
    best_tune = model$bestTune,

    # CV метрики
    cv_metrics = model$results[
      best_tune_idx,
      c("lambda", "ROC", "Acc", "Sens", "Spec")
    ],

    # Коэффициенты (ненулевые)
    coefficients = as.matrix(model$coeffs),

    # Количество отобранных признаков
    n_selected = sum(
      model$coeffs != 0
    ),

    # Метрики на данных
    performance = confusionMatrix(
      as.factor(data_predicted[, levels(y_data)[tumor_idx]] > 0.5),
      as.factor(y_data == levels(y_data)[tumor_idx]),
      positive = "TRUE"
    ),
    roc = roc_data,
    # AUC
    auc = pROC::auc(
      roc_data
    ),
    neg_shap_ratio = model$neg_shap_ratio
  )
}
get_fold_model_summary <- function(model, x_data, y_data, indices, fid) {
  if (any(table(y_data) == 0) || is.null(model)) {
    return(
      list(
        cv_metrics = data.frame(
        ROC = 0,
        Sens = 0,
        Spec = 0,
        Acc = 0
      )
      )
    )
  }
  tumor_idx <- which(
    stri_count_fixed(levels(y_data), "6") > 0
  )
  data_predicted <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = x_data,
    type = "prob"
  )
  pred_class <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = x_data,
    type = "raw"
  )
  roc_data <- pROC::roc(
    y_data,
    data_predicted[, levels(y_data)[tumor_idx]],
    levels = c("class32", "class6"),
    direction = "<"
  )
  metrics_at_0.5 <- pROC::coords(
    roc_data,
    x = 0.5,  # порог
    input = "threshold",
    ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity", "accuracy", "precision")
  )
  pos_class_cnt <- table(
    model$trainingData$.outcome
  )["class6"]
  best_lambda <- model$bestTune$lambda
  coefs <- coef(model$finalModel, s = best_lambda)[-1, 1]
  n_preds <- length(which(coefs != 0))
  list(
    # Гиперпараметры
    cv_metrics = data.frame(
      ROC = as.numeric(roc_data$auc),
      Sens = metrics_at_0.5$sensitivity,
      Spec = metrics_at_0.5$specificity,
      Acc = metrics_at_0.5$accuracy,
      Samples = nrow(model$trainingData),
      TestSize = nrow(x_data),
      PosClassRatio = pos_class_cnt / nrow(model$trainingData),
      n_preds = n_preds
    ),
    pred = data.frame(
      rowIndex = indices,       # индексы строк
      obs = y_data,                   # реальные классы
      pred = pred_class,              # предсказанные классы
      class6 = data_predicted$class6,      # вероятность class6
      class32 = data_predicted$class32,    # вероятность class32
      Resample = paste0("Fold", fid)    # имя фолда
    ),
    coefs = coefs
  )
}
create_group_folds <- function(data, k = 5) {
  # ============================================
  # Группированная стратифицированная CV
  # ============================================
  n_cols <- ncol(data)
  groups <- data[, n_cols]  # например, ID клиентов

  # Получаем уникальные группы для каждого класса
  groups_class6 <- unique(groups[data$class == "6"])
  groups_class32 <- unique(groups[data$class == "32"])
  # Перемешиваем группы
  groups_class6_shuffled <- sample(groups_class6)
  groups_class32_shuffled <- sample(groups_class32)

  # Размер фолда для групп
  fold_size_groups6 <- floor(length(groups_class6_shuffled) / k)
  fold_size_groups32 <- floor(length(groups_class32_shuffled) / k)

  # Создаем фолды
  folds <- list()
  for (i in 1:k) {
    # Группы class6 для валидации
    start6 <- (i - 1) * fold_size_groups6 + 1
    end6 <- ifelse(
      i == k, length(groups_class6_shuffled), i * fold_size_groups6
    )
    test_groups6 <- groups_class6_shuffled[start6:end6]

    # Группы class32 для валидации
    start32 <- (i - 1) * fold_size_groups32 + 1
    end32 <- ifelse(
      i == k, length(groups_class32_shuffled), i * fold_size_groups32
    )
    test_groups32 <- groups_class32_shuffled[start32:end32]

    # Индексы для валидации (все строки с этими группами)
    test_idx <- which(groups %in% c(test_groups6, test_groups32))
    folds[[i]] <- test_idx
  }
  folds
}
alg_cv <- function(data, repeats = 10, k = 3) {
  if (dim(data)[1] <= 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  # n_cols <- ncol(data)
  category_column_idx <- which(names(data) == "class")
  if (length(unique(data[, category_column_idx])) < 2 ||
    min(table(as.numeric(data[, category_column_idx]))) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  set.seed(202022026)
  # посмотреть коэффициенты моделей, сколько там ненулевых.
  # низкая специфичность - это плохо.
  # нужно сделать CV, проверять на проверочном наборе.
  # проверить, что специфичность считается правильно
  # посмотреть в caret one-class-classifier
  train_control <- trainControl(
    method = "none",
    classProbs = TRUE,
    summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
    savePredictions = TRUE
  )
  lambda_grids <- expand.grid(
    alpha = 1,
    lambda = 10^(seq(-4, 0, length = 20))
  )
  cv_data <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(lambda_grids)), function(al) {
    tune_grid <- lambda_grids[al, ]
    repeats_data <- lapply(seq_len(repeats), function(rep) {
      groups_kfolds <- create_group_folds(data, k = k)
      folds_data <- lapply(seq_along(groups_kfolds), function(fid) {
        validating_index <- groups_kfolds[[fid]]
        x <- data[-validating_index, 1:(category_column_idx - 1)]
        y <- as.factor(
          paste0("class", data[-validating_index, category_column_idx])
        )
        y <- factor(y, levels = c("class6", "class32"))
        x_test <- data[validating_index, 1:(category_column_idx - 1)]
        y_test <- as.factor(
          paste0("class", data[validating_index, category_column_idx])
        )
        y_test <- factor(y_test, levels = c("class6", "class32"))
        if (min(table(y)) < 2) {
          fold_model <- NULL
        } else {
          fold_model <- caret::train(
            x = x, y = y,
            method = "glmnet",
            family = "binomial",
            trControl = train_control,
            tuneGrid = tune_grid,
            preProcess = "scale"
          )
        }
        fold_metrics <- get_fold_model_summary(
          fold_model, x_test, y_test, validating_index, fid
        )
        fold_metrics$cv_metrics$neg_shap_ratio <- length(
          which(data[-validating_index, "shapley"] < 0)
        ) / nrow(x)
        predictor_intensities <- x |>
          select(names(x)[which(fold_metrics$coefs != 0)]) |>
          mutate(
            class = y,
            fid = fid,
            rep = rep
          )
        list(
          model = fold_model,
          metrics = fold_metrics,
          coefficients = fold_metrics$coefs,
          fold_shapley = data.frame(
            shapley = data[-validating_index, "shapley"],
            fid = fid
          ),
          predintens = predictor_intensities
        )
      })
      fd_metrics <- ldply(folds_data, function(fd) fd$metrics$cv_metrics)
      fd_preds <- ldply(
        folds_data, function(fd) fd$metrics$pred
      )
      fd_preds$lambda <- tune_grid$lambda
      fd_preds$Resample <- paste0(
        "Rep", rep, fd_preds$Resample
      )
      fd_metrics$resample <- paste0(
        "Rep", rep, "Fold", seq_along(groups_kfolds)
      )
      fd_coefs <- ldply(folds_data, function(fd) {
        reshape2::melt(
          fd$predintens,
          id.vars = c("class", "fid", "rep"),
          variable.name = "MZ",
          value.name = "intensity"
        )
      })
      list(
        lambda = tune_grid$lambda[[1]],
        resample = fd_metrics,
        pred = fd_preds,
        coefs = fd_coefs
      )
    })
    rd_preds <- ldply(
      repeats_data, function(rd) rd$pred
    )
    predictors <- ldply(repeats_data, function(rd) rd$coefs)
    predictors$class <- as.factor(predictors$class)
    rep_resamples <- ldply(repeats_data, function(rd) rd$resample)
    rd_preds$lambda <- tune_grid$lambda
    mean_metrics <- colMeans(rep_resamples[, 1:4])
    list(
      metrics = mean_metrics,
      lambda = tune_grid$lambda[[1]],
      resample = rep_resamples,
      pred = rd_preds,
      predictors_df = predictors
    )
  })
  all_metrics <- ldply(cv_data, function(cvd) cvd$metrics)
  all_metrics$alpha <- 1
  all_metrics$lambda <- sapply(cv_data, function(cvd) cvd$lambda)
  idx <- which.max(all_metrics$ROC)
  best_tune <- all_metrics[idx, ]
  x <- data[, 1:(category_column_idx - 1)]
  y <- as.factor(paste0("class", data[, category_column_idx]))
  y <- factor(y, levels = c("class6", "class32"))
  best_model <- caret::train(
    x = x, y = y,
    method = "glmnet",
    family = "binomial",
    trControl = train_control,
    tuneGrid = best_tune[, c("alpha", "lambda")],
    preProcess = "scale"
  )
  bestModel_coefs <- coef(best_model$finalModel, s = best_tune$lambda)[-1, 1]
  predictor_intensities <- x |>
    select(names(x)[which(bestModel_coefs != 0)]) |>
    mutate(
      class = y
    )
  list(
    bestModel = best_model,
    bestTune = best_tune,
    results = all_metrics,
    coeffs = bestModel_coefs,
    resample = cv_data[[idx]]$resample,
    pred = cv_data[[idx]]$pred,
    predictors_df = cv_data[[idx]]$predictors_df,
    neg_shap_ratio = length(
      which(data[, "shapley"] < 0)
    ) / nrow(data),
    bestModel_predictors = predictor_intensities
  )
}

valid_cv <- function(model, test_data) {
  category_column_idx <- which(names(test_data) == "class")
  if (is.null(model)) {
    cat("model is null\n")
    return(
      list(
        acc = 0,
        se = 0,
        sp = 0
      )
    )
  }
  x_test <- test_data[, 1:(category_column_idx - 1)]
  y_test <- as.factor(
    paste0("class", test_data[, category_column_idx])
  )
  ext_info <- get_cv_model_summary(
    model, x_test, y_test
  )
  list(
    acc = ext_info$performance$overall[["Accuracy"]],
    se = ext_info$performance$byClass[["Sensitivity"]],
    sp = ext_info$performance$byClass[["Specificity"]],
    n_selected = ext_info$n_selected,
    ROC = ext_info$auc,
    ROC_resampling = ext_info$cv_metrics$ROC,
    p_value = ext_info$performance$overall[[6]],
    ext_info = ext_info
  )
}
extract_cv_metrics <- function(model, dataset_name, pred = NULL) {
  # Извлекаем результаты по каждому фолду
  cv_results <- model$resample
  pred_data <- model$pred
  if (is.null(pred_data)) {
    pred_data <- pred
  }

  accuracy_by_fold <- pred_data %>%
    group_by(Resample) %>%
    summarise(
      Acc_0.5 = mean((class6 >= 0.5) == (obs == "class6"), na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  acc_summary <- accuracy_by_fold %>%
    summarise(
      Acc_mean = mean(Acc_0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
      Acc_sd = sd(Acc_0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_folds = n()
    )
  metrics_summary <- cv_results %>%
    summarise(
      ROC_mean = mean(ROC, na.rm = TRUE),
      ROC_sd = sd(ROC, na.rm = TRUE),
      Sens_mean = mean(Sens, na.rm = TRUE),
      Sens_sd = sd(Sens, na.rm = TRUE),
      Spec_mean = mean(Spec, na.rm = TRUE),
      Spec_sd = sd(Spec, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_folds = n()
    )
    
  result <- metrics_summary %>%
    mutate(
      Acc_mean = acc_summary$Acc_mean,
      Acc_sd = acc_summary$Acc_sd
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset = dataset_name,
      ROC_lower = ROC_mean - 1.96 * ROC_sd / sqrt(n_folds),
      ROC_upper = ROC_mean + 1.96 * ROC_sd / sqrt(n_folds),
      Sens_lower = Sens_mean - 1.96 * Sens_sd / sqrt(n_folds),
      Sens_upper = Sens_mean + 1.96 * Sens_sd / sqrt(n_folds),
      Spec_lower = Spec_mean - 1.96 * Spec_sd / sqrt(n_folds),
      Spec_upper = Spec_mean + 1.96 * Spec_sd / sqrt(n_folds),
      Acc_lower = Acc_mean - 1.96 * Acc_sd / sqrt(n_folds),
      Acc_upper = Acc_mean + 1.96 * Acc_sd / sqrt(n_folds)
    )
  result
}
my_dotplot <- function(plot_data, caption_str, scales = "fixed") {
  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(value, name)
  ) +
    facet_grid(. ~ Metric, scales = scales) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(color = ds), width = 0.4) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 15)) +
    # Подписи
    labs(
      caption = caption_str,
      x = "Metric value",
      y = NULL,
      color = "Ions"
    ) +
    # Тема
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      # strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "white"),
      # strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#2c3e50", color = NA),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
    )
}
plot_roc <- function(validated_models, ds_names, mode_name) {
  ldply(
    seq_along(validated_models), function(vm_idx) {
      vm <- validated_models[[vm_idx]]
      data.frame(
        fpr = 1 - vm$ext_info$roc$specificities,
        tpr = vm$ext_info$roc$sensitivities,
        data_set = ds_names[[vm_idx]],
        exp_mode = mode_name
      )
    }
  )
}
get_patient_info <- function(tissue, conn) {
  ldply(tissue, function(t) {
    sqlQuery(
      conn,
      paste0(get_patient_info_query, t, "';"),
      stringsAsFactors = TRUE, as.is = TRUE
    )
  })
}
```

```{r input.params}
diags_info <- ldply(
  params$options$diags_data[1, ],
  function(d) {
    sqlQuery(conn, paste0(getDiagQ, d))
  }
)
hlt_idx <- which(diags_info$id == 32)
if (length(hlt_idx) > 0) {
  diags_info[hlt_idx, c("name", "description", "ref")] <- c(
    "Unmodified", "Quasi-healthy brain", NA
  )
}
```

В работе используются масс-спектрометрические данные, полученные с образцов тканей головного мозга человека с диагнозами \textbf{`r diags_info$name[[1]]`} и патологии не-опухолевой природы. Данные были получены с помощью масс-спектрометра Thermo LTQ XL Orbitrap ETD (Thermo Fisher Scientific; США) с картриджной ионизацией [@Pekov2021a; @bormotov_incorporation_2023].

Предварительная обработка масс-спектрометрических данных производилась с использованием параметров, указанных в таблице \ref{tab:paramstable}. Значения параметров взяты из результатов работы по определению оптимальных значений параметров предварительной обработки [@zavorotnyuk_determining_2024].


## Acquisition parameters

```{r loadata}
dataset_dirs <- list.dirs(options$work_dir, recursive = FALSE)
dataset_dirs <- dataset_dirs[
  stri_count_regex(
    dataset_dirs,
    "expt_\\d\\.res_\\d"
  ) == 1
]
data_envs <- lapply(
  dataset_dirs,
  function(d) {
    cat(
      "Processing data from ",
      d, "\n",
      file = log_file,
      append = TRUE
    )
    shap_env <- new.env()
    shap_env$acq_params <- get_acquisition_params(d)
    if (shap_env$acq_params$pol_id == 1) {
      shap_env$data_set_name <- "Negative"
    }
    if (shap_env$acq_params$pol_id == 2) {
      shap_env$data_set_name <- "Positive"
    }
    shap_path <- d
    tmp_files <- list.files(
      file.path(shap_path, "temp_data"),
      pattern = paste0(
        diags_info$id[[1]], "_", diags_info$id[[2]], "_tmp.RData"
      )
    )
    tmp_files_info <- cbind(
      tmp_files,
      file.info(
        file.path(shap_path, "temp_data", tmp_files)
      )
    )
    fresh_file <- tmp_files_info[
      order(tmp_files_info$mtime, decreasing = TRUE),
    ][1,]
    cat(
      "Read data from ",
      file.path(
        shap_path,
        "temp_data",
        fresh_file$tmp_files[[1]]
      ), "\n",
      file = log_file,
      append = TRUE
    )
    load(
      file.path(
        shap_path,
        "temp_data",
        fresh_file$tmp_files[[1]]
      ),
      envir = shap_env
    )
    shap_env$all_fm_data <- new.env()
    load(
      file.path(
        shap_path, "all_fm_data.RData"
      ),
      envir = shap_env$all_fm_data
    )
    shap_env$train_test_data <- new.env()
    load(
      file.path(shap_path, "train_test_set.Rdata"),
      envir = shap_env$train_test_data
    )
    shap_env$smote_data <- new.env()
    load(
      file.path(shap_path, "averaged_features.RData"),
      envir = shap_env$smote_data
    )
    shap_env$cat.col.number <- ncol(shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_set)
    shap_env$shap_calculated <- shap_env$phiLast

    shap_env$diags.info <- diags_info
    shap_env$feature_matrix <- shap_env$all_fm_data$full_fm
    tcp_data_file <- file.path(
      d,
      "..","..","..",
      "tcp_data.rds"
    )
    shap_env$tcp_data_table <- readRDS(tcp_data_file)

    shap_env$shap_trained_mdT <- rbind(
      shap_env$all_fm_data$full_meta_data[
        shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_idx,
      ],
      shap_env$all_fm_data$avg_meta_data
    )
    shap_env$shap_trained_mdT <- cbind(
      shap_env$shap_trained_mdT,
      shap_env$train_test_data$shap_train_set[, "class"]
    )
    shap_env$ms_spectra <- readRDS(
      file.path(
        d,
        "ms_spectra.rds"
      )
    )
    shap_env$rf_model <- readRDS(
      file.path(
        d,
        "rf_model_avg.rds"
      )
    )
    shap_env
  }
)
```

## Model qualities

### Test dataset
```{r modelqual}
alg <- function(data) {
  if (dim(data)[1] <= 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  cat.col.number <- ncol(data)
  if (length(unique(data[, cat.col.number])) < 2 ||
    min(table(as.numeric(data[, cat.col.number]))) < 2) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  # посмотреть коэффициенты моделей, сколько там ненулевых.
  # низкая специфичность - это плохо.
  # нужно сделать CV, проверять на проверочном наборе.
  # проверить, что специфичность считается правильно
  # посмотреть в caret one-class-classifier
  x <- data[, 1:(cat.col.number - 1)]
  y <- data[, cat.col.number]
  model_lambda <-
    glmnet(as.matrix(x),
      y,
      alpha = 1,
      family = "binomial"
    )
  if (is.null(model_lambda)) {
    cat("Model_lambda is null")
  }
  model_lambda
}

validF <- function(model, test_data) {
  cat.col.number <- ncol(test_data)
  if (is.null(model)) {
    cat("model is null\n")
    return(
      list(
        acc = max(table(test_data[, cat.col.number]) / dim(test_data)[1]),
        se = max(table(test_data[, cat.col.number]) / dim(test_data)[1]),
        sp = max(table(test_data[, cat.col.number]) / dim(test_data)[1])
      )
    )
  }
  AIC <- deviance(model) + 2 * model$df
  best_s <- which.min(AIC)
  x_test <- test_data[, 1:(cat.col.number - 1)]
  y_test <- test_data[, cat.col.number]
  tumor_id <- levels(y_test)[[which(stri_count_fixed(levels(y_test), "6") > 0)]]
  nontumor_id <- levels(y_test)[[which(
    stri_count_fixed(levels(y_test), "32") > 0
  )]]
  new_x <- as.matrix(x_test)
  pred <- as.numeric(predict(
    model,
    newx = new_x,
    type = "class",
    s = model$lambda[[best_s]]
  ))
  conf_matrix <- table(
    Fact = y_test,
    Prediction = pred == tumor_id
  )
  if (dim(conf_matrix)[[2]] == 1) {
    dim_name <- attributes(conf_matrix)$dimnames[[2]][[1]]
    if (dim_name == "TRUE") {
      tp <- conf_matrix[tumor_id, "TRUE"]
      tn <- 0
      fp <- conf_matrix[nontumor_id, "TRUE"]
      fn <- 0
    } else {
      fn <- conf_matrix[tumor_id, "FALSE"]
      tp <- 0
      tn <- conf_matrix[nontumor_id, "FALSE"]
      fp <- 0
    }
  } else {
    tp <- conf_matrix[tumor_id, "TRUE"]
    tn <- conf_matrix[nontumor_id, "FALSE"]
    fp <- conf_matrix[nontumor_id, "TRUE"]
    fn <- conf_matrix[tumor_id, "FALSE"]
  }
  list(
    acc = (tp + tn) / (tp + tn + fp + fn),
    se = tp / (tp + fn),
    sp = tn / (fp + tn)
  )
}
models_data  <- ldply(
  data_envs,
  function(de) {
    common_ds_model <- alg(de$train_test_data$shap_train_set)
    common_valid <- validF(
      common_ds_model,
      de$train_test_data$shap_test_set
    )
    true_ds <- de$train_test_data$shap_train_set
    true_ds$class <- as.factor(de$shap_trained_mdT$diagnosis)
    true_annotation_ds_model  <- alg(true_ds)
    true_valid <- validF(
      true_annotation_ds_model,
      de$train_test_data$shap_test_set
    )
    pos_idx <- which(de$shap_calculated > 0)
    pos_ds <- de$train_test_data$shap_train_set[pos_idx, ]
    pos_ds$class <- as.factor(de$shap_trained_mdT[pos_idx, "diagnosis"])
    pos_ds_model  <- alg(pos_ds)
    pos_valid <- validF(
      pos_ds_model,
      de$train_test_data$shap_test_set
    )
    data.frame(
      annotation = c("mixed", "true", "pos_shapley"),
      acc = c(common_valid$acc, true_valid$acc, pos_valid$acc),
      se = c(common_valid$se, true_valid$se, pos_valid$se),
      sp = c(common_valid$sp, true_valid$sp, pos_valid$sp),
      Data = de$data_set_name
    )
  }
)
kable(
  models_data[, seq_len(ncol(models_data) - 1)],
  format = "latex", caption = "Models quality",
  row.names = FALSE, booktabs = TRUE,
  col.names = c(
    "Annotation", "Accuracy", "Sensitivity",
    "Specificity"
  )
) %>%
  group_rows(index = table(models_data$Data)) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "HOLD_position"), font_size = 10)
```

## Model qualities with CV

Без препроцессинга, 5 фолдов с 10 повторениями.

Разделяем на фолды по EMSID.

### Test dataset
```{r modelqualcv, cache=FALSE}
models_data_plot  <- lapply(
  data_envs,
  function(de) {
    set.seed(202022026)
    if (file.exists(file.path(
        "~",
        paste0(de$data_set_name, "modelqualcv.RData")
      ))) {
      load(file.path(
        "~",
        paste0(de$data_set_name, "modelqualcv.RData")
      ))
      pos_idx <- which(de$shap_calculated[-not_training_idx] > 0)
    } else {
      tissues_data <- de$all_fm_data$result_meta_data |>
        select(tissue, diagnosis) |>
        distinct()
      patients_data <- cbind(
        tissues_data,
        get_patient_info(tissues_data$tissue, conn)
      )
      patients_data <- patients_data |>
        mutate(
          emsid = as.factor(emsid),
          sex = as.factor(sex),
          age = if_else(is.na(age), -1, age)
        )
      all_meta_data <- left_join(
        de$all_fm_data$result_meta_data,
        patients_data |> select(-diagnosis),
        by = "tissue"
      )
      shap_trained_meta_data <- left_join(
        de$shap_trained_mdT,
        patients_data |> select(-diagnosis),
        by = "tissue"
      )
      patients_not_trained <- shap_trained_meta_data |>
        select(emsid, diagnosis) |>
        distinct() |>
        slice_sample(n = 4, by = diagnosis)

      not_training_idx <- which(
        shap_trained_meta_data$emsid %in% patients_not_trained$emsid
      )
      data_cv <- cbind(
        de$train_test_data$shap_train_set[-not_training_idx, ],
        shap_trained_meta_data$emsid[-not_training_idx]
      )
      names(data_cv)[[ncol(data_cv)]] <- "group"
      validating_idx <- which(
        all_meta_data$emsid %in% patients_not_trained$emsid
      )
      not_trained_df <- as.data.frame(cbind(
        de$all_fm_data$result_fm[validating_idx, ],
        de$all_fm_data$result_meta_data[validating_idx, "diagnosis"]
      ))
      names(not_trained_df) <- names(de$train_test_data$shap_test_set)
      test_ds <- not_trained_df
      names(test_ds) <- names(
        de$train_test_data$shap_train_set
      )
      common_ds_model <- alg_cv(data_cv, k = 5)
      common_valid <- valid_cv(
        common_ds_model,
        test_ds
      )
      true_ds <- data_cv
      true_ds$class <- de$shap_trained_mdT$diagnosis[-not_training_idx]
      # true_ds$group <- de$shap_trained_mdT$tissue[-not_training_idx]
      true_annotation_ds_model  <- alg_cv(true_ds, k = 5)
      true_valid <- valid_cv(
        true_annotation_ds_model,
        test_ds
      )
      pos_idx <- which(de$shap_calculated[-not_training_idx] > 0)
      pos_ds <- true_ds[pos_idx, ]
      pos_ds_model  <- alg_cv(pos_ds, k = 5)
      pos_valid <- valid_cv(
        pos_ds_model,
        test_ds
      )
    }

    res_df <- data.frame(
      annotation = c("Mixed annotation", "True annotation", "Positive Shapley"),
      acc = c(common_valid$acc, true_valid$acc, pos_valid$acc),
      se = c(common_valid$se, true_valid$se, pos_valid$se),
      sp = c(common_valid$sp, true_valid$sp, pos_valid$sp),
      n_pred = c(
        common_valid$n_selected, true_valid$n_selected, pos_valid$n_selected
      ),
      ROC = c(common_valid$ROC, true_valid$ROC, pos_valid$ROC),
      Samples = c(nrow(data_cv), nrow(true_ds), nrow(pos_ds)),
      pval = c(common_valid$p_value, true_valid$p_value, pos_valid$p_value),
      Data = de$data_set_name
    )
    resampling_df <- data.frame(
      annotation = c("Mixed annotation", "True annotation", "Positive Shapley"),
      acc = c(
        common_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Acc,
        true_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Acc,
        pos_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Acc
      ),
      se = c(
        common_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Sens,
        true_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Sens,
        pos_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Sens
      ),
      sp = c(
        common_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Spec,
        true_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Spec,
        pos_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Spec
      ),
      ROC = c(
        common_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$ROC,
        true_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$ROC,
        pos_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$ROC
      ),
      Data = de$data_set_name
    )
    common_resample <- reshape2::melt(
      common_ds_model$resample[, c(
        "ROC", "Sens", "Spec", "resample"
      )], variable.name = "Metric"
    )
    common_resample$name <- "Mixed annotation"
    true_ann_resample <- reshape2::melt(
      true_annotation_ds_model$resample[, c(
        "ROC", "Sens", "Spec", "resample"
      )], variable.name = "Metric"
    )
    true_ann_resample$name <- "True annotation"
    pos_resample <- reshape2::melt(
      pos_ds_model$resample[, c(
        "ROC", "Sens", "Spec", "resample"
      )], variable.name = "Metric"
    )
    pos_resample$name <- "Positive Shapley"
    all_resample <- bind_rows(common_resample, true_ann_resample, pos_resample)
    all_resample$name <- factor(
      all_resample$name,
      levels = c("Mixed annotation", "True annotation", "Positive Shapley")
    )
    common_resample2 <- reshape2::melt(
      common_ds_model$resample[, c(
        "Samples", "TestSize", "PosClassRatio", "n_preds", "resample"
      )], variable.name = "Metric"
    )
    common_resample2$name <- "Mixed annotation"
    true_ann_resample2 <- reshape2::melt(
      true_annotation_ds_model$resample[, c(
        "Samples", "TestSize", "PosClassRatio", "n_preds", "resample"
      )], variable.name = "Metric"
    )
    true_ann_resample2$name <- "True annotation"
    pos_resample2 <- reshape2::melt(
      pos_ds_model$resample[, c(
        "Samples", "TestSize", "PosClassRatio", "n_preds", "resample"
      )], variable.name = "Metric"
    )
    pos_resample2$name <- "Positive Shapley"
    all_resample2 <- bind_rows(
      common_resample2, true_ann_resample2, pos_resample2
    )
    all_resample2$name <- factor(
      all_resample2$name,
      levels = c("Mixed annotation", "True annotation", "Positive Shapley")
    )
    # p <- my_dotplot(all_resample)
    common_valid$ext_info$data_set <- "Mixed annotation"
    true_valid$ext_info$data_set <- "True annotation"
    pos_valid$ext_info$data_set <- "Positive Shapley"

    common_valid$ext_info$exp_mode <- de$data_set_name
    true_valid$ext_info$exp_mode <- de$data_set_name
    pos_valid$ext_info$exp_mode <- de$data_set_name
    p_roc <- rbind(
      data.frame(
        fpr = 1 - common_valid$ext_info$roc$specificities,
        tpr = common_valid$ext_info$roc$sensitivities,
        data_set = common_valid$ext_info$data_set,
        exp_mode = common_valid$ext_info$exp_mode,
        auc = round(common_valid$ext_info$auc, 3)
      ),
      data.frame(
        fpr = 1 - true_valid$ext_info$roc$specificities,
        tpr = true_valid$ext_info$roc$sensitivities,
        data_set = true_valid$ext_info$data_set,
        exp_mode = true_valid$ext_info$exp_mode,
        auc = round(true_valid$ext_info$auc, 3)
      ),
      data.frame(
        fpr = 1 - pos_valid$ext_info$roc$specificities,
        tpr = pos_valid$ext_info$roc$sensitivities,
        data_set = pos_valid$ext_info$data_set,
        exp_mode = pos_valid$ext_info$exp_mode,
        auc = round(pos_valid$ext_info$auc, 3)
      )
    )
    tissue_shap_df <- bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        tissue = data_cv$group,
        shapley = de$shap_calculated[-not_training_idx],
        ds = "Mixed annotation"
      ),
      data.frame(
        tissue = true_ds$group,
        shapley = de$shap_calculated[-not_training_idx],
        ds = "True annotation"
      ),
      data.frame(
        tissue = pos_ds$group,
        shapley = de$shap_calculated[-not_training_idx][pos_idx],
        ds = "Positive Shapley"
      )
    ) |>
      mutate(
        tissue = as.factor(tissue),
        ds = as.factor(ds), exp_mode = de$data_set_name
      )
    if (!file.exists(
      file.path(
          "~",
          paste0(de$data_set_name, "modelqualcv.RData"))
    )) {
      save(
        de, res_df, tissue_shap_df,
        p_roc, not_training_idx, all_meta_data,
        patients_data, patients_not_trained,
        data_cv, test_ds, common_ds_model, common_valid,
        true_ds, true_annotation_ds_model, true_valid,
        pos_ds, pos_ds_model, pos_valid,
        file = file.path(
          "~",
          paste0(de$data_set_name, "modelqualcv.RData")
        )
      )
    }

    list(
      df = res_df,
      plot_data = all_resample,
      roc_plot = p_roc,
      resampling_df = resampling_df,
      plot_data2 = all_resample2,
      tissue_shap_df = tissue_shap_df
    )
  }
)
```

### Averaged scans' shapley with full dataset

По рассчитанным Shapley предсказываем значения для всех данных.

Данные делим на обучающую и проверочную выборки (3:1), строим модель с кросс-валидацией и проверяем модель.

Сравниваем модели на всех Shapley-значениях и на только положительных Shapley.
```{r predshapfullcv, cache=FALSE}
models_data_plot  <- lapply(
  data_envs,
  function(de) {
    set.seed(202022026)
    if (file.exists(file.path(
      "~",
      paste0(de$data_set_name, "predshapfullcv.RData")))) {
      load(file.path(
        "~",
        paste0(de$data_set_name, "predshapfullcv.RData")
      ))
      not_training_idx <- which(
        all_meta_data$emsid %in% emsid_not_trained
      )
      pred_shap <- predict(
        de$rf_model$finalModel,
        de$all_fm_data$result_fm[-not_training_idx, ]
      )
      pos_idx <- which(pred_shap > 0)
    } else {
      tissues_data <- de$all_fm_data$result_meta_data |>
        select(tissue, diagnosis) |>
        distinct()
      patients_data <- cbind(
        tissues_data,
        get_patient_info(tissues_data$tissue, conn)
      )
      patients_data <- patients_data |>
        mutate(
          emsid = as.factor(emsid),
          sex = as.factor(sex),
          age = if_else(is.na(age), -1, age)
        )
      all_meta_data <- left_join(
        de$all_fm_data$result_meta_data,
        patients_data |> select(-diagnosis),
        by = "tissue"
      )
      patients_by_diags <- all_meta_data |>
        select(emsid, diagnosis) |>
        distinct()
      patients_by_diags <- patients_by_diags |>
        mutate(
          probs = n() / nrow(patients_by_diags),
          .by = diagnosis
        )
      emsid_not_trained <- sample(
        patients_by_diags$emsid, prob = patients_by_diags$probs, size = 8
      )

      not_training_idx <- which(
        all_meta_data$emsid %in% emsid_not_trained
      )
      result_fm_df <- as.data.frame(de$all_fm_data$result_fm[-not_training_idx, ])
      pred_shap <- de$pred_shap[-not_training_idx, ]
      result_fm_df$class <- de$all_fm_data$result_meta_data[
        -not_training_idx, "diagnosis"
      ]
      result_fm_df$group <- all_meta_data$emsid[
        -not_training_idx
      ]
      train_groups <- sample(
        unique(result_fm_df$group),
        size = length(unique((result_fm_df$group))) * 0.75
      )
      train_idx <- which(result_fm_df$group %in% train_groups)
      test_ds <- as.data.frame(de$all_fm_data$result_fm[not_training_idx, ])
      test_ds$class <- de$all_fm_data$result_meta_data[
        not_training_idx, "diagnosis"
      ]
      common_ds_model  <- alg_cv(result_fm_df, k = 5)
      common_valid <- valid_cv(
        common_ds_model,
        test_ds
      )

      pos_idx <- which(pred_shap > 0)
      pos_ds <- result_fm_df[pos_idx, ]
      pos_ds_model  <- alg_cv(pos_ds, k = 5)
      pos_valid <- valid_cv(
        pos_ds_model,
        test_ds
      )
    }

    res_df <- data.frame(
      annotation = c("All data", "Positive Shapley"),
      acc = c(common_valid$acc, pos_valid$acc),
      se = c(common_valid$se, pos_valid$se),
      sp = c(common_valid$sp, pos_valid$sp),
      n_pred = c(
        common_valid$n_selected, pos_valid$n_selected
      ),
      ROC = c(common_valid$ROC, pos_valid$ROC),
      Samples = c(nrow(result_fm_df), nrow(pos_ds)),
      pval = c(common_valid$p_value, pos_valid$p_value),
      Data = de$data_set_name
    )
    resampling_df <- data.frame(
      annotation = c("Mixed annotation", "Positive Shapley"),
      acc = c(
        common_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Acc,
        pos_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Acc
      ),
      se = c(
        common_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Sens,
        pos_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Sens
      ),
      sp = c(
        common_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Spec,
        pos_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$Spec
      ),
      ROC = c(
        common_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$ROC,
        pos_valid$ext_info$cv_metrics$ROC
      ),
      Data = de$data_set_name
    )
    common_resample <- reshape2::melt(
      common_ds_model$resample[, c(
        "ROC", "Sens", "Spec", "resample"
      )], variable.name = "Metric"
    )
    common_resample$name <- "All data"
    pos_resample <- reshape2::melt(
      pos_ds_model$resample[, c(
        "ROC", "Sens", "Spec", "resample"
      )], variable.name = "Metric"
    )
    pos_resample$name <- "Positive Shapley"
    all_resample <- bind_rows(common_resample, pos_resample)
    all_resample$name <- factor(
      all_resample$name,
      levels = c("All data", "Positive Shapley")
    )
    common_resample2 <- reshape2::melt(
      common_ds_model$resample[, c(
        "Samples", "TestSize", "PosClassRatio", "n_preds", "resample"
      )], variable.name = "Metric"
    )
    common_resample2$name <- "All data"
    pos_resample2 <- reshape2::melt(
      pos_ds_model$resample[, c(
        "Samples", "TestSize", "PosClassRatio", "n_preds", "resample"
      )], variable.name = "Metric"
    )
    pos_resample2$name <- "Positive Shapley"
    all_resample2 <- bind_rows(common_resample2, pos_resample2)
    all_resample2$name <- factor(
      all_resample2$name,
      levels = c("All data", "Positive Shapley")
    )
    common_valid$ext_info$data_set <- "All data"
    pos_valid$ext_info$data_set <- "Positive Shapley"

    common_valid$ext_info$exp_mode <- de$data_set_name
    pos_valid$ext_info$exp_mode <- de$data_set_name
    p_roc <- rbind(
      data.frame(
        fpr = 1 - common_valid$ext_info$roc$specificities,
        tpr = common_valid$ext_info$roc$sensitivities,
        data_set = common_valid$ext_info$data_set,
        exp_mode = common_valid$ext_info$exp_mode,
        auc = round(common_valid$ext_info$auc, 3)
      ),
      data.frame(
        fpr = 1 - pos_valid$ext_info$roc$specificities,
        tpr = pos_valid$ext_info$roc$sensitivities,
        data_set = pos_valid$ext_info$data_set,
        exp_mode = pos_valid$ext_info$exp_mode,
        auc = round(pos_valid$ext_info$auc, 3)
      )
    )
    tissue_shap_df <- bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        tissue = result_fm_df$group,
        shapley = pred_shap,
        ds = "All data"
      ),
      data.frame(
        tissue = pos_ds$group,
        shapley = pred_shap[pos_idx],
        ds = "Positive Shapley"
      )
    ) |>
      mutate(
        tissue = as.factor(tissue),
        ds = as.factor(ds), exp_mode = de$data_set_name
      )
    if (!file.exists(file.path(
        "~",
        paste0(de$data_set_name, "predshapfullcv.RData")))) {
      save(
        de, res_df, pred_shap, tissue_shap_df,
        p_roc, all_meta_data,
        patients_data, test_ds, emsid_not_trained,
        result_fm_df, train_groups, train_idx, common_ds_model, common_valid,
        pos_ds, pos_ds_model, pos_valid,
        file = file.path(
          "~",
          paste0(de$data_set_name, "predshapfullcv.RData"))
      )          
    }

    list(
      df = res_df,
      # plot = p,
      plot_data = all_resample,
      roc_plot = p_roc,
      resampling_df = resampling_df,
      plot_data2 = all_resample2,
      tissue_shap_df = tissue_shap_df
    )
  }
)
```

### Downsampling

Perform downsampling with 10 repeats.

```{r modelqualcvdns, cache=FALSE}
repeats <- 10
downsmpl_length <- 700

train_validate_downsampling <- function(
  data_cv, test_ds, repeats = 10, downsmpl_length = 700
) {
  downsmpl_data <- lapply(seq_len(repeats), function(i) {
    tr_samples_idx <- sample(
      seq_len(nrow(data_cv)), size = downsmpl_length
    )
    ds_model <- alg_cv(data_cv[tr_samples_idx, ], k = 5)
    list(
      model_data = ds_model,
      validation_data = valid_cv(
        ds_model,
        test_ds
      )
    )
  })
  model_metrics <- ldply(seq_along(downsmpl_data), function(dcd_idx) {
    dcd <- downsmpl_data[[dcd_idx]]$validation_data
    data.frame(
      rep = dcd_idx,
      acc = dcd$acc,
      se = dcd$se,
      sp = dcd$sp,
      n_pred = dcd$n_selected,
      ROC = dcd$ROC,
      NSR = dcd$ext_info$neg_shap_ratio
    )
  })
  model_roc <- ldply(seq_along(downsmpl_data), function(dcd_idx) {
    dcd <- downsmpl_data[[dcd_idx]]
    dcd$model_data$resample |>
      select(ROC, resample) |>
      mutate(rep = dcd_idx)
  })
  model_predictors <- ldply(seq_along(downsmpl_data), function(dcd_idx) {
    dcd <- downsmpl_data[[dcd_idx]]
    reshape2::melt(
      dcd$model_data$bestModel_predictors,
      id.vars = c("class"),
      variable.name = "MZ",
      value.name = "intensity"
    ) |>
      mutate(rep = dcd_idx)
  })
  proc <- ldply(seq_along(downsmpl_data), function(dcd_idx) {
    dcd <- downsmpl_data[[dcd_idx]]$validation_data
    data.frame(
      rep = dcd_idx,
      fpr = 1 - dcd$ext_info$roc$specificities,
      tpr = dcd$ext_info$roc$sensitivities,
      auc = round(dcd$ext_info$auc, 3)
    )
  })
  list(
    model_metrics = model_metrics,
    summary = colMeans(model_metrics),
    roc = model_roc,
    proc = proc,
    predictors = model_predictors
  )
}

models_data_plot  <- lapply(
  data_envs,
  function(de) {
    set.seed(202022026)
    samples_cnt <- ifelse(
      de$data_set_name == "Negative", 700, 300
    )
    if (file.exists(
      file.path(
        "~",
        paste0(de$data_set_name, "modelqualcv_downsmpl.RData")
      )
    )) {
      load(file.path(
        "~",
        paste0(de$data_set_name, "modelqualcv_downsmpl.RData")
      ))
    } else {
      tissues_data <- de$all_fm_data$result_meta_data |>
        select(tissue, diagnosis) |>
        distinct()
      patients_data <- cbind(
        tissues_data,
        get_patient_info(tissues_data$tissue, conn)
      )
      patients_data <- patients_data |>
        mutate(
          emsid = as.factor(emsid),
          sex = as.factor(sex),
          age = if_else(is.na(age), -1, age)
        )
      all_meta_data <- left_join(
        de$all_fm_data$result_meta_data,
        patients_data |> select(-diagnosis),
        by = "tissue"
      )
      shap_trained_meta_data <- left_join(
        de$shap_trained_mdT,
        patients_data |> select(-diagnosis),
        by = "tissue"
      )
      patients_not_trained <- shap_trained_meta_data |>
        select(emsid, diagnosis) |>
        distinct() |>
        slice_sample(n = 4, by = diagnosis)

      not_training_idx <- which(
        shap_trained_meta_data$emsid %in% patients_not_trained$emsid
      )
      data_cv <- de$train_test_data$shap_train_set[-not_training_idx, ] |>
        mutate(
          group = shap_trained_meta_data$emsid[-not_training_idx],
          shapley = de$shap_calculated[-not_training_idx]
        )
      validating_idx <- which(
        all_meta_data$emsid %in% patients_not_trained$emsid
      )
      not_trained_df <- as.data.frame(cbind(
        de$all_fm_data$result_fm[validating_idx, ],
        de$all_fm_data$result_meta_data[validating_idx, "diagnosis"]
      ))
      names(not_trained_df) <- names(de$train_test_data$shap_test_set)
      test_ds <- not_trained_df
      names(test_ds) <- names(
        de$train_test_data$shap_train_set
      )
      true_ds <- data_cv
      true_ds$class <- de$shap_trained_mdT$diagnosis[-not_training_idx]
      pos_idx <- which(de$shap_calculated[-not_training_idx] > 0)
      pos_ds <- true_ds[pos_idx, ]
      samples_cnt <- min(
        nrow(data_cv), nrow(true_ds), nrow(pos_ds)
      )

      downsmpl_common_data <- train_validate_downsampling(
        data_cv, test_ds,
        downsmpl_length = samples_cnt
      )
      
      downsmpl_true_data <- train_validate_downsampling(
        true_ds, test_ds,
        downsmpl_length = samples_cnt
      )
      
      downsmpl_pos_data <- train_validate_downsampling(
        pos_ds, test_ds,
        downsmpl_length = samples_cnt
      )
      res_df <- data.frame(
        annotation = c(
          "Mixed annotation", "True annotation", "Positive Shapley"
        ),
        acc = c(
          downsmpl_common_data$summary[["acc"]],
          downsmpl_true_data$summary[["acc"]],
          downsmpl_pos_data$summary[["acc"]]
        ),
        se = c(
          downsmpl_common_data$summary[["se"]],
          downsmpl_true_data$summary[["se"]],
          downsmpl_pos_data$summary[["se"]]
        ),
        sp = c(
          downsmpl_common_data$summary[["sp"]],
          downsmpl_true_data$summary[["sp"]],
          downsmpl_pos_data$summary[["sp"]]
        ),
        n_pred = c(
          downsmpl_common_data$summary[["n_pred"]],
          downsmpl_true_data$summary[["n_pred"]],
          downsmpl_pos_data$summary[["n_pred"]]
        ),
        ROC = c(
          downsmpl_common_data$summary[["ROC"]],
          downsmpl_true_data$summary[["ROC"]],
          downsmpl_pos_data$summary[["ROC"]]
        ),
        NSR = c(
          downsmpl_common_data$summary[["NSR"]],
          downsmpl_true_data$summary[["NSR"]],
          downsmpl_pos_data$summary[["NSR"]]
        ),
        Samples = c(samples_cnt, samples_cnt, samples_cnt),
        Data = de$data_set_name
      )
      resampling_df <- rbind(
        downsmpl_common_data$model_metrics |>
          mutate(
            annotation = "Mixed annotation",
            Data = de$data_set_name
          ),
        downsmpl_true_data$model_metrics |>
          mutate(
            annotation = "True annotation",
            Data = de$data_set_name
          ),
        downsmpl_pos_data$model_metrics |>
          mutate(
            annotation = "Positive Shapley",
            Data = de$data_set_name
          )
      )
      common_resample <- reshape2::melt(
        downsmpl_common_data$roc, variable.name = "Metric"
      )
      common_resample$name <- "Mixed annotation"
      true_ann_resample <- reshape2::melt(
        downsmpl_true_data$roc, variable.name = "Metric"
      )
      true_ann_resample$name <- "True annotation"
      pos_resample <- reshape2::melt(
        downsmpl_pos_data$roc, variable.name = "Metric"
      )
      pos_resample$name <- "Positive Shapley"
      all_resample <- bind_rows(
        common_resample, true_ann_resample, pos_resample
      )
      all_resample$name <- factor(
        all_resample$name,
        levels = c("Mixed annotation", "True annotation", "Positive Shapley")
      )

      p_roc <- rbind(
        downsmpl_common_data$proc |>
          mutate(
            data_set = "Mixed annotation",
            exp_mode = de$data_set_name
          ),
        downsmpl_true_data$proc |>
          mutate(
            data_set = "True annotation",
            exp_mode = de$data_set_name
          ),
        downsmpl_pos_data$proc |>
          mutate(
            data_set = "Positive Shapley",
            exp_mode = de$data_set_name
          )
      )
      p_roc$data_set <- factor(
        p_roc$data_set,
        levels = c("Mixed annotation", "True annotation", "Positive Shapley")
      )
      all_preds <- rbind(
        downsmpl_common_data$predictors |>
          mutate(
            data_set = "Mixed annotation",
            exp_mode = de$data_set_name
          ),
        downsmpl_true_data$predictors |>
          mutate(
            data_set = "True annotation",
            exp_mode = de$data_set_name
          ),
        downsmpl_pos_data$predictors |>
          mutate(
            data_set = "Positive Shapley",
            exp_mode = de$data_set_name
          )
      )
      all_preds$data_set <- factor(
        all_preds$data_set,
        levels = c("Mixed annotation", "True annotation", "Positive Shapley")
      )
      all_preds <- all_preds |>
        mutate(
          max_int = max(intensity), .by = MZ
        )
      mu <- mean(all_preds$max_int)
      sigma <- sd(all_preds$max_int)
      all_preds$group <- cut(
        all_preds$max_int,
        breaks = c(-Inf, mu - sigma, mu, mu + sigma, Inf),
        labels = c("VeryLow", "BelowMedian", "Median", "AboveMedian"),
        include.lowest = TRUE
      )
      save(
        de, res_df, resampling_df,
        p_roc, not_training_idx, all_meta_data,
        patients_data, patients_not_trained,
        data_cv, test_ds, downsmpl_common_data,
        true_ds, downsmpl_true_data, all_resample,
        pos_ds, downsmpl_pos_data, all_preds,
        file = file.path(
          "~",
          paste0(de$data_set_name, "modelqualcv_downsmpl.RData")
        )
      )
    }
    list(
      df = res_df,
      plot_data = all_resample,
      roc_plot = p_roc,
      resampling_df = resampling_df,
      all_preds = all_preds
    )
  }
)
```

```{r}
roc_data <- lapply(models_data_plot, function(mdp) {
  all_preds <- mdp$all_preds
  all_preds$mz_fact <- factor(
    all_preds$MZ, levels = sort(unique(levels(all_preds$MZ)))
  )
  exp_mode <- unique(all_preds$exp_mode)
  groups <- levels(all_preds$group)
  lapply(seq_along(groups), function(gid) {
    g_file_path <- file.path(
      "~",
      paste0(
        exp_mode, "_calc_predictors_",
        groups[gid], ".pdf"
      )
    )
    cairo_pdf(filename = g_file_path, width = 8, height = 20)
    if (nrow(all_preds |> filter(group == groups[gid])) > 0) {
      print(ggplot(all_preds |> filter(group == groups[gid])) +
        labs(
          title = paste("Predictors", groups[gid], "intens")
        ) +
        facet_grid(. ~ data_set) +
        geom_violin(aes(y = mz_fact, color = class, x = intensity)) +
        labs(
          y = "MZ"
        ) +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold")
        ))
    }
    dev.off()
  })
  breaks <- quantile(
    as.numeric(levels(all_preds$MZ)), probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 4)
  )
  labels <- paste0(
    "(",
    format(head(breaks, -1), digits = 5), ", ",
    format(tail(breaks, -1), digits = 5), "]"
  )
  all_preds$mz_value <- as.numeric(as.character(all_preds$MZ))
  all_preds$qlabel <- cut(
    all_preds$mz_value,
    breaks = breaks,
    labels = labels,
    include.lowest = TRUE
  )
  qgroup <- levels(all_preds$qlabel)
  lapply(seq_along(qgroup), function(qid) {
    g_file_path <- file.path(
      "~",
      paste0(
        exp_mode, "_calc_predictors_mz_",
        groups[qid], ".pdf"
      )
    )
    cairo_pdf(filename = g_file_path, width = 8, height = 20)
    if (nrow(all_preds |> filter(qlabel == qgroup[qid])) > 0) {
      print(ggplot(all_preds |> filter(qlabel == qgroup[qid])) +
        labs(
          title = paste("Predictors", qgroup[qid], "MZ")
        ) +
        facet_grid(. ~ data_set) +
        geom_violin(aes(y = mz_fact, color = class, x = intensity)) +
        labs(y = "MZ") +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold")
        ))
    }
    dev.off()
  })
})
```

```{r predshapqualcvdns, cache=FALSE}
models_data_plot  <- lapply(
  data_envs,
  function(de) {
    set.seed(202022026)
    samples_cnt <- ifelse(
      de$data_set_name == "Negative", 4500, 4000
    )
    if (file.exists(file.path(
      "~",
      paste0(de$data_set_name, "predshapfullcv_downsmpl.RData")))) {
      load(file.path(
        "~",
        paste0(de$data_set_name, "predshapfullcv_downsmpl.RData")
      ))
      not_training_idx <- which(
        all_meta_data$emsid %in% emsid_not_trained
      )
      pred_shap <- predict(
        de$rf_model$finalModel,
        de$all_fm_data$result_fm[-not_training_idx, ]
      )
      pos_idx <- which(pred_shap > 0)
    } else {
      tissues_data <- de$all_fm_data$result_meta_data |>
        select(tissue, diagnosis) |>
        distinct()
      patients_data <- cbind(
        tissues_data,
        get_patient_info(tissues_data$tissue, conn)
      )
      patients_data <- patients_data |>
        mutate(
          emsid = as.factor(emsid),
          sex = as.factor(sex),
          age = if_else(is.na(age), -1, age)
        )
      all_meta_data <- left_join(
        de$all_fm_data$result_meta_data,
        patients_data |> select(-diagnosis),
        by = "tissue"
      )
      patients_by_diags <- all_meta_data |>
        select(emsid, diagnosis) |>
        distinct()
        # slice_sample(n = 4, by = diagnosis)
      patients_by_diags <- patients_by_diags |>
        mutate(
          probs = n() / nrow(patients_by_diags),
          .by = diagnosis
        )
      emsid_not_trained <- sample(
        patients_by_diags$emsid, prob = patients_by_diags$probs, size = 8
      )

      not_training_idx <- which(
        all_meta_data$emsid %in% emsid_not_trained
      )
      result_fm_df <- as.data.frame(
        de$all_fm_data$result_fm[-not_training_idx, ]
      )
      names(result_fm_df) <- attributes(de$all_fm_data$result_fm)$mass
      # pred_shap <- de$pred_shap[-not_training_idx, ]
      pred_shap <- predict(
        de$rf_model$finalModel,
        de$all_fm_data$result_fm[-not_training_idx, ]
      )
      result_fm_df$class <- de$all_fm_data$result_meta_data[
        -not_training_idx, "diagnosis"
      ]
      result_fm_df$group <- all_meta_data$emsid[
        -not_training_idx
      ]
      result_fm_df$shapley <- pred_shap
      train_groups <- sample(
        unique(result_fm_df$group),
        size = length(unique((result_fm_df$group))) * 0.75
      )
      train_idx <- which(result_fm_df$group %in% train_groups)
      test_ds <- as.data.frame(de$all_fm_data$result_fm[not_training_idx, ])
      names(test_ds) <- attributes(de$all_fm_data$result_fm)$mass
      test_ds$class <- de$all_fm_data$result_meta_data[
        not_training_idx, "diagnosis"
      ]
      pos_idx <- which(pred_shap > 0)
      pos_ds <- result_fm_df[pos_idx, ]
      samples_cnt <- min(
        nrow(result_fm_df), nrow(pos_ds)
      )
      downsmpl_common_data <- train_validate_downsampling(
        result_fm_df, test_ds,
        downsmpl_length = samples_cnt
      )
      downsmpl_pos_data <- train_validate_downsampling(
        pos_ds, test_ds,
        downsmpl_length = samples_cnt
      )
    }
    res_df <- data.frame(
      annotation = c("All data", "Positive Shapley"),
      acc = c(
        downsmpl_common_data$summary[["acc"]],
        downsmpl_pos_data$summary[["acc"]]
      ),
      se = c(
        downsmpl_common_data$summary[["se"]],
        downsmpl_pos_data$summary[["se"]]
      ),
      sp = c(
        downsmpl_common_data$summary[["sp"]],
        downsmpl_pos_data$summary[["sp"]]
      ),
      n_pred = c(
        downsmpl_common_data$summary[["n_pred"]],
        downsmpl_pos_data$summary[["n_pred"]]
      ),
      ROC = c(
        downsmpl_common_data$summary[["ROC"]],
        downsmpl_pos_data$summary[["ROC"]]
      ),
      NSR = c(
        downsmpl_common_data$summary[["NSR"]],
        downsmpl_pos_data$summary[["NSR"]]
      ),
      Samples = c(samples_cnt, samples_cnt),
      Data = de$data_set_name
    )
    resampling_df <- rbind(
      downsmpl_common_data$model_metrics |>
        mutate(
          annotation = "All data",
          Data = de$data_set_name
        ),
      downsmpl_pos_data$model_metrics |>
        mutate(
          annotation = "Positive Shapley",
          Data = de$data_set_name
        )
    )
    common_resample <- reshape2::melt(
      downsmpl_common_data$roc, variable.name = "Metric"
    )
    common_resample$name <- "All data"
    pos_resample <- reshape2::melt(
      downsmpl_pos_data$roc, variable.name = "Metric"
    )
    pos_resample$name <- "Positive Shapley"
    all_resample <- bind_rows(common_resample, pos_resample)
    all_resample$name <- factor(
      all_resample$name,
      levels = c("All data", "Positive Shapley")
    )

    p_roc <- rbind(
      downsmpl_common_data$proc |>
        mutate(
          data_set = "All data",
          exp_mode = de$data_set_name
        ),
      downsmpl_pos_data$proc |>
        mutate(
          data_set = "Positive Shapley",
          exp_mode = de$data_set_name
        )
    )
    p_roc$data_set <- factor(
        p_roc$data_set,
        levels = c("All data", "Positive Shapley")
      )
    all_preds <- rbind(
      downsmpl_common_data$predictors |>
        mutate(
          data_set = "All data",
          exp_mode = de$data_set_name
        ),
      downsmpl_pos_data$predictors |>
        mutate(
          data_set = "Positive Shapley",
          exp_mode = de$data_set_name
        )
    )
    all_preds$data_set <- factor(
      all_preds$data_set,
      levels = c("All data", "Positive Shapley")
    )
    all_preds <- all_preds |>
        mutate(
          max_int = max(intensity), .by = MZ
        )
      mu <- mean(all_preds$max_int)
      sigma <- sd(all_preds$max_int)
      all_preds$group <- cut(
        all_preds$max_int,
        breaks = c(-Inf, mu - sigma, mu, mu + sigma, Inf),
        labels = c("VeryLow", "BelowMedian", "Median", "AboveMedian"),
        include.lowest = TRUE
      )
    if (!file.exists(file.path(
        "~",
        paste0(de$data_set_name, "predshapfullcv_downsmpl.RData")))) {
      save(
        de, res_df, resampling_df, patients_by_diags,
        p_roc, not_training_idx, all_meta_data,
        patients_data, emsid_not_trained,
        test_ds, downsmpl_common_data,
        all_resample, result_fm_df, all_preds,
        pos_ds, downsmpl_pos_data,
          file = file.path(
            "~",
            paste0(de$data_set_name, "predshapfullcv_downsmpl.RData"))
        )
    }
    list(
      df = res_df,
      plot_data = all_resample,
      roc_plot = p_roc,
      resampling_df = resampling_df,
      all_preds = all_preds
    )
  }
)
models_data <- ldply(
  models_data_plot,
  function(mdp) mdp$df
)
kable(
  models_data[, seq_len(ncol(models_data) - 1)],
  format = "latex", caption = "Mean models quality",
  row.names = FALSE, booktabs = TRUE,
  col.names = c(
    "Annotation", "Accuracy", "Sensitivity",
    "Specificity", "NPreds", "ROC", "NSR", "Samples"
  )
) %>%
  group_rows(index = table(models_data$Data)) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "HOLD_position"), font_size = 10)
```

```{r predshapqualcvrocplotdns, dev="cairo_pdf", fig.height=6, fig.width=8, fig.align = "center", cache=FALSE}
roc_data <- ldply(models_data_plot, function(mdp) {
  mdp$roc_plot
})
auc_labels <- roc_data |>
  summarise(
    max = max(auc),
    min = min(auc),
    mean = round(mean(auc), digits = 3),
    sd = round(sd(auc), digits = 3), .by = c(exp_mode, data_set)
  ) |>
  mutate(
      # Позиция для подписи (можно настроить)
      x = 0.5,
      y = 0.3
  )
roc_data$rep <- as.factor(roc_data$rep)
data_tb <- tibble::tibble(
  x = "right", y = "bottom",
  tb = lapply(seq_len(nrow(auc_labels)), function(i) {
    auc_labels[i, ] |> select(min, max, mean, sd)
  }),
  data_set = auc_labels$data_set,
  exp_mode = auc_labels$exp_mode
)
ggplot(roc_data, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, color = rep)) +
  facet_grid(exp_mode ~ data_set, scales = "fixed") +
  # ROC-кривая
  geom_line() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, 
              linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_table_npc(
    data = data_tb,
    aes(npcx = x, npcy = y, label = tb),
    parse = TRUE,
    table.colnames = TRUE,
    table.theme = ttheme_gtlight
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    caption = "Сравнение ROC-кривых (Full datast)",
    x = "False Positive Rate",
    y = "True Positive Rate",
    color = "Датасет"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
roc_data <- lapply(models_data_plot, function(mdp) {
  all_preds <- mdp$all_preds
  all_preds$mz_fact <- factor(
    all_preds$MZ, levels = sort(unique(levels(all_preds$MZ)))
  )
  exp_mode <- unique(all_preds$exp_mode)
  groups <- levels(all_preds$group)
  lapply(seq_along(groups), function(gid) {
    g_file_path <- file.path(
      "~",
      paste0(
        exp_mode, "_regr_predictors_",
        groups[gid], ".pdf"
      )
    )
    cairo_pdf(filename = g_file_path, width = 8, height = 20)
    if (nrow(all_preds |> filter(group == groups[gid])) > 0) {
      print(ggplot(all_preds |> filter(group == groups[gid])) +
        labs(
          title = paste("Predictors", groups[gid], "intens")
        ) +
        facet_grid(. ~ data_set) +
        geom_violin(aes(y = mz_fact, color = class, x = intensity)) +
        labs(y = "MZ") +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold")
        ))
    }
    dev.off()
  })
  breaks <- quantile(
    as.numeric(levels(all_preds$MZ)), probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 4)
  )
  labels <- paste0(
    "(",
    format(head(breaks, -1), digits = 5), ", ",
    format(tail(breaks, -1), digits = 5), "]"
  )
  all_preds$mz_value <- as.numeric(as.character(all_preds$MZ))
  all_preds$qlabel <- cut(
    all_preds$mz_value,
    breaks = breaks,
    labels = labels,
    include.lowest = TRUE
  )
  qgroup <- levels(all_preds$qlabel)
  lapply(seq_along(qgroup), function(qid) {
    g_file_path <- file.path(
      "~",
      paste0(
        exp_mode, "_regr_predictors_mz_",
        groups[qid], ".pdf"
      )
    )
    cairo_pdf(filename = g_file_path, width = 8, height = 20)
    if (nrow(all_preds |> filter(qlabel == qgroup[qid])) > 0) {
      print(ggplot(all_preds |> filter(qlabel == qgroup[qid])) +
        labs(
          title = paste("Predictors", qgroup[qid], "MZ")
        ) +
        facet_grid(. ~ data_set) +
        geom_violin(aes(y = mz_fact, color = class, x = intensity)) +
        labs(y = "MZ") +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold")
        ))
    }
    dev.off()
  })
})
```
